activeSlice.scope: Ground Hunter V2 shadow deep analysis in the matched public retrieval evidence and specific development, then evaluate quality on the same three-brand, three-repetition cohort. Keep V1 authority, source budgets, scoring rubric and rollout thresholds unchanged.
successCriteria: Deep analysis receives bounded public title, summary, URL, publisher and date for matching supporting signals, plus the specific cluster subject and Brand name.
The deep output still passes the domain validator and exact candidate identity check.
No quality-delta, retrieval, failure, latency, cost, exploration or topic-share rollout threshold changes.
V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass; rerun one 3x3 on exact approved merge SHA before any 30-pair gate. Stop if quality or failure remains outside policy.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: The paced nine-pair run completed with all 18 deep requests succeeding, but quality and latency failed. Deep requests received numeric summaries without actual article content, producing generic or off-topic angles. Startup flags were cleared after completion.
